note: Runnable tool scripts for the Admin panel. To add a script, drop it in src/tools/ and add an entry here. Each script must export an async main(opts) that accepts {limit} (0 = all) and returns the produced JSON in result.json.

scripts.label: Ranking / quality
scripts.description: Fetches GitHub stars + last-commit (shields.io) and hub docs for the whole catalog, computes every theme's quality score and A.1-style sub-rank (computeRanks in src/data.js), and produces the data for src/quality.json. Full run takes 1-3 min; use a limit for a quick test.

scripts.label: Categories
scripts.description: Fetches every hub theme description and classifies themes into the style/palette + structural categories (src/data.js) for src/categories.json. Full run takes 1-2 min; use a limit for a quick test.
